strongest_angle: Analyzes the effectiveness and usability of wearable trunk posture feedback systems deployed in a six-week longitudinal study at a distribution center by researchers including Jiwon Choi and Maury A. Nussbaum.

key_facts.fact: Researchers Jiwon Choi, Sunwook Kim, Sol Lim, Ryan Porto, and Maury A. Nussbaum published a longitudinal field study in Applied Ergonomics examining a trunk posture feedback system over a duration of up to six weeks.

The study titled Effectiveness and usability of a trunk posture feedback system: A longitudinal field study for up to six weeks in a distribution center was published in Volume 136 of Applied Ergonomics.
The institutional repository VTechWorks hosts the accepted version of the research paper authored by Jiwon Choi and colleagues from Virginia Tech.
